svg.text: bypass_rb: the bypass capacitors of vcm and vref, in a cell of their own
Christoph, 2026-11-07: distinct from vcm_rb and vref_s2d_rb, "6 on vref, 4 on vcm". hv NMOS to vss, the s2d pad's load-capacitor
device type. vcm_rb keeps its CB (the buffer's phase margin); vref_s2d_rb has none (no loop). NMOS to vss only: PMOS to iovdd
couples iovdd into vref, the S2D's zero point (explore_bypass.py).
Shapes as drawn in the layout (pad_ref_rb v2, agent F): the gate area of the 12u x 12u array they replace, vref 9 x 144 um2, vcm 4 x 144 um2;
"capacitor placement is pretty much ad lib (maintaining overall capacitance to the nodes and avoiding long interconnects)". Drawn from netlist/source/pad_ref_rb.spice
